name: You, Me, and the Stars
source:
In the last few days of summer, you take a camping trip with your best friend, Aster... At least... You think it's your best friend...

[From [url=https://undeadbeesgames.itch.io/you-me-and-the-stars]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在夏末最后的几天里，你与挚友阿斯特一同踏上了露营之旅…至少…你以为那是你的挚友…
